title: Nested YAML: schema words versus a literal password: must not be flagged
summary: YAML where `password:` heads a schema (`minLength: 12`) or a reference (`secretKeyRef`). Covers 2 inputs.
rationale: Nesting hides the connection between a key and its value. A scanner must tell a schema or a reference under a password key apart from a real literal in the same structure.

expectation.rationale: Placeholder, tutorial, reference, template or mask control whose expected silence follows a closed redact-secret issue decision, not a universal secret definition.
